title: Some improvments
body: I would like to be able to change the details of a goal without resetting/deleting all existing data on that goal. Furthermore, and honestly more importantly, some of the daily quotes seem completely BS and low effort to platitudes. I hoped I could use them as daily mantras but honestly so many of them are such trash. It would be really nice if you spend some more time finding/developing more helpful ones. Especially the “anonymous” ones should just go. No quote needs to have my name on it, and even worse, the word “*name*”. On that note, some light backgrounds make it quite hard to read the white letters on them.

I needed a way to build some healthy habits that eventually merge into a routine. I am on a vacation right now, so I haven’t worked with habit tracker in normal life, however I feel confident it will help me, because I simply have all my ‘new habits’ in one app and in the overview I can simply see how I am doing.

title: Uncluttered & great
body:
This app is great because it is very uncluttered unlike e.g. the “streaks” app. However, it would be fantastic if there was a pomodoro timer built in the app. E.g. for studying, if you put 60 minutes in, it does not automatically split the task. You can just run the built in timer for 60 minutes but not for 2x30 for example. That would be the first step to make this app really fantastic for me. The second step would then be to also add “breaks” automatically, such that you see you need to: (20 mins work, 10 mins rest) x4 and then get 30 mins of rest. For now I’ll use a different app for the pomodoro and afterwards add it to the “habit” app, but it would be fantastic if it was built in. A quick solution for the developer is the following: allow people to repeat a task multiple times on a day. I could for example then set that number to 12 such that I can work for 12x 30 minutes a day.

  Another suggestion I have is to add more health things. For example the amounts of calories taken in. Just like in the streaks app it would be great if it would have an option for calory deficit. This could be calculated with a formula from info that is already available in the health app: suggested kcal intake - kcal eaten + kcal burned. Those are the only 2 features im missing to make it truly great for me. However, because it’s the only app with such a clear uncluttered and simple UI, I will use it and buy premium. Thanks for making this app!
